Now these people bear some resemblance to the character of self-control, just as the
prodigal to the liberal or the rash man to the brave, but they are different in many
The man of self-control does not change by reason of passion and lust, yet when occasion
so requires he will be easy of persuasion.
But the positive man changes not at the call of reason, though many of this class take
up certain desires and are led by their pleasures.
Among the class of positive are the opinionated, the ignorant, and the bearish.
